picks.title: Saturated Saturday: When God Doesn’t Do What You Think He Should — Pastor Jason Shepperd
picks.summary:
What happens to your faith when God doesn’t do what you think a good God should do?
The gospel doesn’t promise a life without pain. It gives us hope in the middle of it. In 2 Samuel 12, David faces unimaginable loss and has a decision to make: will his pain cause him to stop seeking God, or lead him into deeper trust and surrender?
Grace doesn’t disappear when pain enters our lives, and God’s character doesn’t change when our circumstances do.The gospel includes suffering, but it ends in resurrection. Because the tomb is empty, pain does not get the final word.

picks.reason: A pastor reflects on faith, suffering, and trust amid loss using biblical narrative.

picks.showTitle: The Permanent Questions With David Brooks
picks.title: What Is the Meaning of Mystical Experience?
picks.summary:
What would it be like to wake up one day with the ability to greet the world with warmth, patience, grace, and affection? This is what happens to the main character in the Pulitzer Prize–winner Ayad Akhtar's magnificent new novel, The Radiance. It is a tale of spiritual transformation in which Akhtar gives a detailed description of our inner landscapes. David and Akhtar talk about what it's like to see the world with new eyes, and how difficult it is to move from the head to the heart.
